channel.description: Latest articles from Acoustic Guitar Magazine (acousticguitar.com)

item.title: Sean McGowan | How I Play | Improvising with CAGED
item.description: Learn how to use shapes you already know as a practical tool for soloing.

item.title: Build Flatpicking Skills Using Classical Guitar Repertoire with Matteo Carcassi’s Etude No. 1
item.description: Mastering a short classical arrangement can be a refreshing break from the routine—and a good way to build some new skills.

item.title: Meredith Moon’s Traveling Folk | Acoustic Guitar Sessions
item.description: The Canadian-born folksinger’s nimble guitar work and captivating vocals are on full display in this stripped-down session.

item.title: Acoustic Guitar NAMM 2026 Report
item.description: Walking through NAMM for hours, what stood out just as much as the guitars themselves were the players, many of them young and clearly invested in the instrument.

item.title: How to Play James Taylor’s Iconic “You’ve Got a Friend”
item.description: This transcription of the Carole King classic comes from the original studio recording—played in G but sounding in A, thanks to a capo at the second fret.

item.title: Review: Volterra Project Trio Explores Drama and Dialogue on ‘Parole in Musica’
item.description: Music drawn from theater, film, and folklore becomes a vehicle for close ensemble playing and thoughtful arrangement.

item.title: Thoughtful Tips for Supporting Others Musically
item.description: Playing the supportive role as a musician calls for heightened awareness, deep listening, patience, and an open mind.

item.title: The Next Generation Grand Auditoriums Have Arrived
item.description: Sponsored by Taylor Guitars: The Grand Auditorium has long been celebrated for its balance, comfort, and musical versatility — a guitar equally at home on the couch, in the studio, or under stage lights. Now, that trusted platform has been thoughtfully reimagined from the inside out. The Next Generation Grand Auditorium introduces a trio of purposeful […]

item.title: Unlock a Powerful New Voice with Dropped-D Tuning
item.description: Whether you fingerpick or flatpick, dropped-D tuning adds depth and texture, and can anchor a melody with a strong, pulsing bass.

item.title: Review: John Gorka Returns with ‘unentitled’
item.description: On his first album in seven years, the folk fixture delivers a set of spare, thoughtful songs grounded in voice and guitar.
